items: Deepak Dhar wins 2026 Dirac Medal (ICTP) — for sandpile model; shared with Bernard Derrida, Marc Mézard, Haim Sompolinsky; instituted 1985, awarded on Dirac's birthday (8 Aug).
Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowships & Awards (2024, 2025) — 115 artists; 7 Fellows incl. Ramlal Bareth, Rita Ganguly; instituted 1952; Fellowship ₹3 lakh vs Award ₹1 lakh.
Sarvottam Jeevan Raksha Padak — 12 rat miners (Silkyara Tunnel rescue); prize ₹2 lakh.
Dr. M.S. Swaminathan Award for Environment Protection 2026 — P. Pechiyammal & Govindhammal, Chennai.
Prof. Karthikeyan Lanka (IIT Bombay) — NASI Young Scientist Award 2026.
National Anubhav Awards 2026 — 15 awardees; conferred by Dr Jitendra Singh.
2026 Candere Hurun India Women Leaders List — Priya Nair = 1st woman CEO & MD of Hindustan Unilever.
Hurun India Most Valuable Family Businesses 2026 — Mukesh Ambani family richest for 3rd consecutive year (₹25.8 lakh Cr). 🎯 🔥 HIGH.
Competere Foundation "India's Next Growth Frontier" — India 82nd (2010) → 57th (2023) on Market Distortions Performance Index.
Mumbai ranks 15th, Hyderabad 27th globally in data-centre capacity — Knight Frank Global Data Centre Atlas 2026 (Mumbai: 15th operational/11th pipeline; Hyderabad: 27th live/19th future).
ZSI completes India's 1st comprehensive Catalogue of Lepidoptera — 13,703 species.
NITI Aayog "Reimagining Care" report — elderly population 149 mn (2022) → projected 347 mn by 2050.
Parle tops Brand Footprint India 2026 (in-home FMCG, 14th consecutive year); Britannia tops out-of-home.
WHO/UNICEF: only 40% of world's health facilities meet basic sanitation standards.
Lancet study — 80%+ of India's elderly could face dangerous heat stress at 3°C warming.
Google tops India's Most Attractive Employer Brand 2026 (Randstad REBR); followed by Tata Group, Amazon.
India's most powerful celebrity 2025 (Kroll India) — Shah Rukh Khan #1 ($177.9 mn); Ranveer Singh #2; Virat Kohli #3.
IMF flags financial stability risks from BigTech in payments.
